$comment: Overlay Extension Schema (Derived). A derived Extension type for the overlay domain that adds the presentation metadata the shell's top bar needs to decide WHICH overlay surface a control opens. The overlay domain instance pins no extensionsTypeId, so a contribution could target it with the bare base type — but GTS refuses to register an instance whose type has no schema, and no schema exists for the base extension type. Modelled on the shell's extension_screen.v1: same derived-type mechanism, same trailing '~', base type pulled in via allOf.

label.$comment: Accessible name of the control that opens this surface (e.g. the top bar's search button)

icon.$comment: Icon identifier for that control (Iconify name with prefix)

route.$comment: Which surface this is, e.g. '/search' or '/inbox'. REQUIRED: this is what the top bar matches on to pick an extension, so an overlay contribution without it is unreachable.

presentation.$comment: Presentation metadata for overlay domain extensions. Drives which top-bar control opens this surface.
